lines.style: clear and gripping, a playful shock
lines.tagged: EVERY ant on Earth just turned, and they're all marching at you.
The first few reach your shoe. Twelve ants. Easy.
Then come the driver ants. Up to twenty MILLION in one column.
Then a colony six thousand kilometers LONG, from Italy to Spain.

lines.style: the key line: big, clear punch, slow and heavy
lines.tagged: Now all twenty QUADRILLION. Coming for you.
That's almost two and a half million for EVERY person alive.
But a driver ant army marches about twenty meters an HOUR.

lines.style: relaxed and amused, a little grin
lines.tagged: You walk over two hundred times faster. Just STROLL away.

lines.style: leaning in, sharing a true story
lines.tagged: Scientists REALLY counted them in twenty twenty two.

lines.style: clear and amazed, a smart reveal
lines.tagged: And all those ants OUTWEIGH every wild bird and mammal combined.
